name: io.github.airgap-fleet/airgap-file-bridge
title: airgap-file-bridge
description: Local-first filesystem MCP bridge with ripgrep search, atomic writes, symlink protection, binary detection, size limits, and multiple transports (stdio/SSE/HTTP). Zero data egress, air-gapped ready.
